verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Datalab converts images and scanned documents into Markdown, HTML or JSON. It also ships OCR models (Chandra, Surya) and processes scans for track-changes extraction, so basic OCR of scanned and photographed input is supported. Nothing in the pack speaks to accuracy on hard inputs. Missing for 10: evidence of handling skewed or rotated pages, stamps and seals, and low-quality or noisy scans; accuracy benchmarks; independent or hands-on corroboration of OCR quality.
